heading: INT. MERIDIAN PLANETARIUM - DOME CHAMBER - NIGHT

units.text: INT. MERIDIAN PLANETARIUM - DOME CHAMBER - NIGHT
A hemisphere of white plaster, the ceiling curved like the inside of an egg.
In the center, a Zeiss star projector crouches on its pedestal like a patient insect.
Rows of reclined seats fan out below, empty, dark.
ZELDA NAKASHIMA-HOLT, 40s, black coveralls, a tool roll slung across her shoulder, stands at the base of the projector with a micrometer and a face like a surgeon's.
MONTGOMERY "MONTY" ABERNATHY, 60s, a former curator in a cardigan, shuffles up the aisle carrying a lantern and a clipboard he has no use for.
RAJESH SUBRAMANIAN, 30s, a hacker with a backpack of laptops, kneels beside a panel in the wall.
SABINE DELACROIX-ODUYA, 30s, a safecracker in a pencil skirt, taps along a seam in the plaster with a stethoscope.
CRISPIN, 12, Monty's grandson, in a school blazer, sits in the front row with his chin on his knees and watches them all.
Raj. Status.
units.name: ZELDA

units.text: Motion sensors off. Cameras are looping the last four minutes of Tuesday.
units.name: RAJESH

units.text: Monty?
units.name: ZELDA

units.text: It's in the cupola, Zelda. Behind the Pleiades. The Director insisted on that. A little theatre.
units.name: MONTY

units.text: Of course he did.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: She presses her ear to the plaster.
Smiles.
Found it. Seam runs vertical, eighteen inches off the Southern Cross.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: Zelda crosses to the projector.
Checks a gauge.
Wipes dust off the lens with her sleeve.
The star field on the dome flickers once.
Grandpa, is it supposed to do that?
units.name: CRISPIN

units.text: God help us, no.
units.name: MONTY

units.text: Rajesh freezes.
A single red LED on his laptop blinks.
Then another.
Then every screen at once.
Somebody just opened a remote session.
units.name: RAJESH

units.text: Whose?
units.name: ZELDA

units.text: Mine.
units.name: RAJESH

units.text: He slams the lid.
The dome flares.
Stars wheel, sweep, collapse into a single white point, and then Monty's own recorded voice, thirty years younger, booms through the speakers like the voice of God:
Welcome to the Meridian Planetarium. Tonight's program is: THE NIGHT SKY OVER AN UNSUSPECTING CITY.
units.name: MONTY

units.text: Sabine drops the stethoscope.
Monty drops the lantern.
The lantern rolls across the aisle and goes out.
The room falls to starlight.
Rajesh, kill it.
units.name: ZELDA

units.text: I'm trying!
units.name: RAJESH

units.text: Is this part of the plan?
units.name: SABINE

units.text: It's the Director's idea of a joke.
units.name: MONTY

units.text: Crispin raises his hand like a good student.
I think I know where the switch is.
units.name: CRISPIN

units.text: All four adults turn.
The boy gets up, walks to a wall panel behind the front row, lifts a flap that none of them noticed, and flips a lever.
The dome fades to black.
The voice dies.
A long beat of silence.
Then the projector begins to turn on its own.
A new star field spins up.
It is not the northern hemisphere.
It is a drawing: a long line of gold pinpricks tracing the outline of a vault door.
Oh, Henry. You clever old man.
units.name: MONTY

units.text: He mapped it.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: He mapped it on the ceiling.
units.name: ZELDA

units.text: Rajesh scrambles for his camera.
Sabine runs for the cupola ladder.
Zelda grabs Monty by the arm and hauls him after her.
Crispin lingers in the aisle, face turned up, lit gold.
Grandpa. That one's you.
units.name: CRISPIN

units.text: He points at a single star, slightly brighter than the rest.
So it is.
units.name: MONTY

units.text: Footsteps in the corridor outside.
Real ones.
Multiple.
Heavy shoes on marble.
A radio crackles.

Zelda and Sabine and Rajesh freeze mid-stride, then scatter: Zelda behind the projector, Sabine flat against the cupola wall, Rajesh down between two rows of seats with a laptop clutched to his chest.
Monty stands in the middle of the aisle, alone and lit with gold, and does the only brave thing he has done in thirty years.
He turns toward the door and smiles.
Gentlemen! You're just in time for the show.
units.name: MONTY
